Sandbox_Deadwire_EnableMod_tooltip: Master switch. Turns off all Deadwire mechanics when disabled. Wires already placed remain in the world but stop functioning.
Sandbox_Deadwire_EnableTier0: Allow tin can trip lines (Tier 0, no skill)
Sandbox_Deadwire_EnableTier0_tooltip: Tin cans on fishing line or twine. No skill required. The most basic alarm available on day one.
Sandbox_Deadwire_EnableTier1: Allow reinforced trip lines and bells (Tier 1)
Sandbox_Deadwire_EnableTier1_tooltip: Wire-based reusable trip lines and bell noisemakers. Requires Carpentry 2 + Trapping 2.
Sandbox_Deadwire_EnableCamouflage_toolti: Players can hide placed wires using foraged materials. Other players need Foraging skill to spot them. Turn off for visible-only wires.
Sandbox_Deadwire_WireMaxPerPlayer_toolti: Limits how many wires a single player can have placed at once. Prevents lag from excessive objects.
Sandbox_Deadwire_WireAffectsZombies_tool: When enabled, zombies walking through a wire will trigger it. Disable to make wires player-only (PvP traps).
Sandbox_Deadwire_WireAffectsPlayers_tool: When enabled, players walking through a wire will trigger it. Disable for PvE-only servers where wires should only affect zombies.
Sandbox_Deadwire_SoundMultiplier_tooltip: Scales all Deadwire sound radii up or down. At 2.0 everything is heard twice as far. Affects zombie attraction distance.
Sandbox_Deadwire_TinCanBreakOnTrigger: Tin can trip lines are single-use
Sandbox_Deadwire_TinCanBreakOnTrigger_to: When enabled, tin can trip lines break after one trigger. Disable to make them reusable.
Sandbox_Deadwire_TripLineHealth_tooltip: Hit points a placed tin can trip line is created with. Nothing damages wires yet, so this has no effect in play until it does.
Sandbox_Deadwire_ReinforcedHealth_toolti: Hit points a placed reinforced trip line is created with. Nothing damages wires yet, so this has no effect in play until it does.
Sandbox_Deadwire_PlayerTripDamage: Damage dealt to players who trip a wire
Sandbox_Deadwire_PlayerTripDamage_toolti: How much foot damage a player takes walking into tanglefoot. Trip lines do no damage. Set to 0 for stumble only.
Sandbox_Deadwire_PlayerTripStumble: Players stumble when tripping a wire
Sandbox_Deadwire_PlayerTripStumble_toolt: Players stagger when they walk into tanglefoot. Trip lines only make noise.
Sandbox_Deadwire_TanglefootTripChance: Chance a zombie trips per tile (%)
Sandbox_Deadwire_TanglefootTripChance_to: Each tile of tanglefoot has this percentage chance of tripping a zombie that walks through it.
Sandbox_Deadwire_TanglefootAffectsCrawle: Crawlers are already on the ground. Enable to make tanglefoot still slow them down.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectLevelLow: Foraging level for faint shimmer detection
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectLevelLow_tool: Players at or above this Foraging level see camouflaged wires as a faint shimmer at close range.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectLevelMid_tool: Players at or above this Foraging level see camouflaged wires as semi-transparent at moderate range.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectLevelFull: Foraging level for full visibility + outline
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectLevelFull_too: Players at or above this Foraging level see camouflaged wires clearly with a colored outline highlight.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectRangeLow_tool: How close a player must be to see the faint shimmer of a camouflaged wire.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectRangeMid_tool: How close a player must be to see a camouflaged wire as semi-transparent.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoDetectRangeFull_too: How close a player must be to see a camouflaged wire with full clarity and outline.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoMaxDurability_toolt: Fresh camouflage starts with this much durability. Higher values mean it lasts longer before wearing off.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoRainDegradeRate: Camouflage durability lost per ten minutes of rain
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoRainDegradeRate_too: Checked every ten in-game minutes while it is raining, and scaled by how hard. Fresh camouflage starts at 100, so at the default a wire is bare after a few hours of steady rain. Set to 0 to disable rain degradation.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoStormMultiplier_too: During thunderstorms, camouflage degrades this many times faster than normal rain.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoTriggerDegrade: Camouflage durability lost per wire trigger
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoTriggerDegrade_tool: Each time a camouflaged wire triggers, the camouflage wears down by this amount.
Sandbox_Deadwire_OwnerWireOutline: Owner and faction see an outline on their own wires
Sandbox_Deadwire_OwnerWireOutline_toolti: The player who placed a wire, and anyone in their faction, sees it drawn with a coloured outline. Applies to every wire they own, camouflaged or not, and the colour says which type it is.
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoVisibleToOwner: Owner always sees their own camouflaged wires
Sandbox_Deadwire_CamoVisibleToOwner_tool: The player who placed a wire always sees it regardless of camouflage. Disable for full blindness.
Sandbox_Deadwire_FriendlyFireWires: Faction members trigger each other's wires
Sandbox_Deadwire_FriendlyFireWires_toolt: When enabled, walking through a faction mate's wire triggers it. Disable so faction members pass through safely.
Sandbox_Deadwire_WireOwnerImmunity: Wire placer is immune to their own wires
Sandbox_Deadwire_WireOwnerImmunity_toolt: The player who placed a wire can walk through it without triggering. Does not apply to other faction members.
Sandbox_Deadwire_AdminBypassCamo: Admins always see all camouflaged wires
Sandbox_Deadwire_AdminBypassCamo_tooltip: Server admins see every camouflaged wire regardless of Foraging level.
Sandbox_Deadwire_LogWirePlacements: Log wire placements to server log
Sandbox_Deadwire_LogWirePlacements_toolt: Every time a player places a wire, it gets written to the server log with coordinates and username.
Sandbox_Deadwire_LogWireTriggers: Log wire triggers to server log
Sandbox_Deadwire_LogWireTriggers_tooltip: Every time a wire triggers, it gets written to the server log. Generates a lot of output.
Sandbox_Deadwire_BellSpawnRate: How often bells appear in loot
Sandbox_Deadwire_BellSpawnRate_tooltip: Controls how commonly bells show up in churches, schools, farms, and reception areas.
Sandbox_Deadwire_SalvageMinPercent: Minimum salvage from a destroyed wire (%)
Sandbox_Deadwire_SalvageMinPercent_toolt: Lowest share of a destroyed wire's durable parts left on the tile. One roll per wire, between this and the maximum. Zero means the line can be a total loss. Cord is never returned: it is what snapped.
Sandbox_Deadwire_SalvageMaxPercent: Maximum salvage from a destroyed wire (%)
Sandbox_Deadwire_SalvageMaxPercent_toolt: Highest share of a destroyed wire's durable parts left on the tile. Set below 100 so that taking a wire back up by hand, which always returns the whole kit, stays the better option.
Sandbox_Deadwire_EnableTier3_tooltip: Electrified deadwire and electrified fences. Both need a powered square nearby, from the grid or a generator.
Sandbox_Deadwire_ShockPlayerDamage_toolt: Damage to one leg or foot when a player touches a live wire or fence. 0 disables the damage but not the knockback.
Sandbox_Deadwire_ShockPanic_tooltip: How badly a shock rattles a player. Panic fades on its own, so a larger number lasts longer as well as hitting harder. 0 disables it.
Sandbox_Deadwire_ShockZombieKillChance: Chance a shock kills a zombie
Sandbox_Deadwire_ShockZombieKillChance_t: Percent chance a shocked zombie dies outright. It is knocked down otherwise.
Sandbox_Deadwire_FencePulseChance_toolti: An energiser pulses on a clock rather than on contact, so this is the chance something touching the fence was touching it when the pulse arrived.
Sandbox_Deadwire_FenceBreakChance_toolti: Percent chance a pulse that hits something also burns out the wiring, which has to be reconnected. The fence itself is never destroyed.
Sandbox_Deadwire_ElectricPowerDraw_toolt: Added to a generator's load, so an electrified perimeter burns fuel like any other appliance.
